title: Thousand cankers disease in Juglans: Optimizing sampling and identification procedures for the vector Pityophthorus juglandis, and the causal agent Geosmithia morbida
author: Moricca, Bracalini, et al.

steps.title: Prepare antibiotic‑supplemented PDA
steps.instruction: Make Potato Dextrose Agar with antibiotics ready for fungal isolation.

substeps.instruction: Dissolve 39 g PDA and 5 g agar per litre of deionized water (Liofilchem Srl).
Autoclave the medium at 121 °C for 15 min.
Cool the sterilized medium to approximately 45 °C (still liquid, below 50 °C).

Add antibiotics: 500 µg ml⁻¹ Ampicillin (Policillin‑N) and 10 µg ml⁻¹ Rifampicin (Rifamycin), previously dissolved in 4 ml absolute ethanol and mixed with 300 ml sterile distilled water, ensuring uniform distribution before solidification.

steps.title: Collect beetles and larvae
steps.instruction: Remove beetles and larvae from bark galleries and place them on the prepared PDA.

substeps.instruction: Using sterilized tweezers, gently remove beetles from galleries and place roughly 50 specimens into a sterile microtube.
Within a few hours transfer the insects onto the surface of the PDA medium.
Locate larvae by digging diagonal tunnels with a sharp knife, lift larvae with the tip of a brush and place them on the medium.
If adults or larvae are still alive and mobile, plate each individually into a 6 cm‑diameter plastic Petri dish to avoid waste of substrate.

steps.title: Swab mycelial mats in galleries
steps.instruction: Lightly swipe a sterile needle over dense whitish mycelial felt in galleries and deposit the material directly onto a PDA‑filled Petri dish.

steps.title: Surface‑sterilize wood fragments
steps.instruction: Sterilize symptomatic wood pieces before plating.

substeps.instruction: Immerse each fragment in 96 % ethanol for 30 s.
Transfer to 4 % NaOCl solution for 4 min.
Rinse again in 96 % ethanol for 30 s.

steps.title: Plate wood fragments on PDA
steps.instruction: Place sterilized wood pieces onto PDA dishes for fungal outgrowth.

substeps.instruction: Peel bark off and aseptically excise wood from the edge zone between healthy and necrotized tissue around holes; also collect random pieces from inside galleries.
On each 9 cm‑diameter plastic Petri dish, arrange five pieces: one in the centre and four at the cardinal points ~1 cm from the dish edge.

steps.title: Incubate and monitor growth
steps.instruction: Observe plates, remove contaminants, and transfer pure colonies after 7 days.

substeps.instruction: Check plates daily; colony initials appear within 24 h.
Promptly discard any plates contaminated by unwanted saprophytic fungi (contamination ≤10 %).
After 7 days of incubation at 24 °C in darkness, select single colonies (average diameter 2–3 cm) and transfer them to fresh PDA without antibiotics.

steps.title: Purify and re‑incubate colonies
steps.instruction: Incubate the transferred pure colonies again at 24 °C in darkness.
